subject: RShiny disconnect grey overlay on mobile after screen turned off/app switch

messages.author: 124c9bce1b29c89a
messages.subject: RShiny disconnect grey overlay on mobile after screen turned off/app switch
parts:
Hi,

We are experiencing a UI issue when viewing an RShiny page on mobile (Safari on iOS 10): 
When the screen turns off after a timeout, or when we switch applications, then switch back to the Shiny site, the session does not disconnect (we can still click links, navigation works), but there is a grey disconnect overlay mask over the page.

We have websockets disabled in our configuration, could it be the issue? Has anyone experienced something similar? Would you have any recommendations?

Thanks and regards,
Daniel

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: RShiny disconnect grey overlay on mobile after screen turned off/app switch
parts:
Are you sure the session is not disconnected? Links will work even if the session is disconnected, but outputs will not update.

If your goal is to not have them disconnect you might also consider using allowReconnect, assuming it's appropriate for your app:
https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/reconnecting.html
